推广文本: Keep important accounts and directions organized. Choose what each trusted person can see, and help them find the next step when it matters.
描述:
Organize the important details someone may need to find.

Rillora helps you create a private map of accounts, documents, devices, subscriptions and other matters. Record where information is kept, what you want to happen and who can help. Keep passwords and recovery secrets out of your map.

CHOOSE WHAT EACH PERSON SEES
Invite a trusted person with a link or QR code. They accept using their own Rillora account and can view only the matters and detail levels you selected. They can use the web without installing the app. Change or revoke sharing whenever you need to.

FIND THE OFFICIAL NEXT STEP
Read preparation and after-death account guidance for common platforms. Relevant guides appear beside supported accounts, with links to the original provider instructions.

KEEP YOUR PLAN USEFUL
Free includes a lightweight text map, one current-updating recipient, official guidance, data export and account controls. Rillora Family supports up to five current-updating recipients, shared reviews and one designated contributor who can suggest corrections for your approval. Rillora Family is offered as an annual subscription.

KEEP CONTROL OF YOUR INFORMATION
Make a private backup, read supported saved files and manage account deletion from My data. Cancelling Family keeps your own map available under Free. Additional accepted recipients may retain their last authorized paid-period copy, subject to your current privacy restrictions and revocation.

Rillora is an organizer, not a will, password manager or account-transfer service. It does not determine death, grant legal authority or automatically release information when you stop signing in. Third-party account requests remain subject to each provider's requirements.

备注:
Rillora is a private organizer for important accounts, documents, devices and directions. It is not a will, password vault or asset-transfer service. It does not infer death or release information automatically.

REVIEW SIGN-IN
Use the dedicated review username and password supplied in the Sign-In Information fields. Open Profile, tap Sign in, enter the existing email address and select sign in (not sign up). Confirm the displayed account terms when prompted. Google and Apple sign-in are optional alternatives; the supplied review account uses email and password.

CORE FLOW
The review account has an empty private map. Add a matter, record a provider/location and directions, then edit it. Profile provides trusted contacts, sharing, Plan & access, and My data. Recipients can also use the web without installing iOS. My data includes export/import and account controls.

SUBSCRIPTION
Free includes one current-updating recipient. Family is annual-only and includes up to five current-updating recipients, shared reviews and one designated contributor whose corrections require the owner to approve them. Open Profile > Plan & access to view the local App Store price and subscribe using Apple Sandbox. Restore purchases and Manage Apple subscriptions are on that page. The review account is enabled for Sandbox; test transactions are kept separate from live customer billing. US annual price: USD119.99. Hong Kong annual price: HKD888.00. The app is free to download.

LANGUAGES
The app supports English and Simplified Chinese. Change the language in Profile settings. English and Chinese store materials are provided separately.
